mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% indicates a deteriorating labor market, signaling economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings growth, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST > 0.5% MoM and RSAFS > 0.3% MoM) indicates robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS meet the trigger conditions, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 above 2.0% annualized) signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth is above 2.0% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 95) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a weak labor market without monetary policy support, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: weak labor market with no policy easing
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both UNRATE > 6.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST below 850) indicate weak residential construction, signaling reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 850, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
